result_summary.title: Analytics Dashboard API errors and webhook retries in Dev (EU-Central)
result_summary.description: We are seeing webhook retries exhausted, HTTP 429 errors, and API schema errors when using the Analytics Dashboard in our EU-Central development environment. We're not sure if the dashboard is returning these errors due to internal processing issues or if a job scheduler is failing to feed it data correctly. No immediate impact, but blocking development.
